data.title: Automatically fix issues with multiple identical dependencies
data.description:
If the issues JSONL file contains identical parent-issues with the same key, it should detect this and just keep one dependency rather than failing. For example, this was introduced as an error in a JSONL file where the same parent was added twice to one issue, and when I ran `fleece list` the command failed with this error:

Error: An item with the same key has already been added. Key: gEb5dI
